payload.verifiable: All thirteen carry a named verify_method: R1-R8 and R10, R12, Q1 by test; R9 by demonstration (a fresh worktree runs the full verify unrepaired); R11 by inspection plus the existing refusal test. None was unnameable, so nothing was rewritten or dropped at this step.
payload.traced: No empty rows. R1 -> S3/prop 3. R2 -> S4/prop 4. R3, R4, R5 -> S1/prop 1. R6 -> S2/prop 2. R7 -> S2 via UC-C. R8 -> S1 (the close must not damage claims). R9, R10 -> S6. R11 -> prop 2 (the record cannot be destroyed). R12 -> S5, the folded no-regression need. Q1 -> prop 4 and the goal system's nothing-lost priority.
payload.functions_cover: Every requirement requires at least one of the thirteen functions, and every use-case step and numbered extension maps to a function - the mapping is recorded in full at derive_functions. F6 (withhold the record) and F7 (preserve reachability) are kept separate on purpose, because conflating them is exactly how a split degrades into a deletion.
payload.set_holds: COMPLETE: every UC-A/B/C/D step and extension is covered, plus the folded regression need. CONSISTENT: every failure path resolves the same way - refuse and leave trunk untouched (R2, R4, R8, Q1); no requirement asks the close to continue past a failure. AFFORDABLE: one engine file plus the bless path; the git operations are ordinary, now demonstrated. BOUNDED: the binding excluded list holds - no reading back from git, no backport, no machine or board change. NO TBD: nothing in the register defers a decision to build time.
payload.breaks_if_removed: Filled on all thirteen, each naming a concrete failure rather than a virtue: work lost with a working directory (R1); a ship reporting success while producing nothing (R2); the record losing its only handle (R3, R4); trunk collecting 57 evidence files per close (R5); the split becoming deletion (R6); every pointer dangling (R7); a conflict resolved by silently dropping paths (R8); every new iteration's first battery dying at tsc (R9); forking from a state that does not match the running engine (R10); history-only content being destroyed (R11); closed iterations vanishing from view (R12); a half-applied close (Q1).
payload.assumptions_probed: Six probed against real git, none deferred (run-aa90b5a988e9): empty-branch detection, tagging before merge, THE CORE - a two-parent merge whose tree omits the event paths, claims merging correctly through the filter, evidence reachable by tag while absent from disk, and composition across a second and third close. All PASS. Consequence for the register: R5 and R6 are now known-achievable rather than hoped-for, and risk R2 (git's memory of a filtered merge) is retired early by evidence rather than left for its revisit trigger.
